name: Omega-3 algae oil capsule
identity: Vegan soft capsule of about 0.5 g microalgae (Schizochytrium) oil with 250 to 300 mg DHA and EPA, as dm and Rossmann sell it; the dose is one capsule.
rule: Per 100 g of the product, each value is the median of the labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three declare it. An algae oil capsule's label states its content as oil (500 mg microalgae oil per capsule on the maker's page), and by that it declares the oil's nutrients: the oil mass is the fat, its energy is 9 kcal per gram, and the oil carries 0 g carbohydrate and 0 g protein; the vegan starch shell is left unstated. The two labels with a full table per 100 g, Mivolis and altapharma, are the check on that understatement: they put the shell at 23 to 32 g carbohydrate and under 0.5 g protein per 100 g, under a fifth of a gram of carbohydrate per capsule, so the capsule's energy, the point of logging it, is within a few percent either way. EPA and DHA are not tracked and stay out. The capsule weight is the pack's net content divided by its count. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from doppelherz.de, dm.de and rossmann.de product pages; nothing a label leaves out becomes zero.
